assumptions_challenged: That the absence of program-specific CMC/analytics/manufacturing artifacts can be established from the MISEV2023 guidance alone
That MISEV2023 content can be used as direct evidence of program-level manufacturing, assay validation, or biodistribution results
That species-specific translatability (rodent to large animal/human) can be concluded from a quality-guidance document without program experimental data
falsification_conditions: Provide MCB/WCB master cell bank characterization documentation (release testing, certificates of analysis, retention vial data) for SGL-001 source cells
Provide analytical method validation reports for the intact-EV assays and orthogonal QC panel showing LLOQ, specificity, accuracy/precision, linearity, and robustness
Provide a validated, stability-indicating, mechanism-linked potency assay and data demonstrating correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint (fit-for-purpose qualification report and bridging data)
Provide reports from ≥3 GMP-like scale-up production runs including draft release specifications, certificate(s) of analysis, and stability data demonstrating lot-to-lot reproducibility
Provide intact-EV recovery/compatibility data for the proposed formulation/device both ex vivo and in vivo with appropriate controls and method descriptions
Provide species-specific biodistribution/toxicology reports using intact-EV–specific analytics that demonstrate or refute rodent-to-large-animal CNS delivery translatability
strongest_objection: The reviewers treat program-level absences (MCB/WCB, validated intact-EV assays, GMP-like batch/stability data, validated potency assay, intact-EV recovery/compatibility and species-specific biodistribution) as established facts despite the evidence set containing only the MISEV2023 consensus guideline; the guideline prescribes what should be reported but does not itself demonstrate that any program-specific artifacts are missing or present. Conclusions that the program ‘does not demonstrate’ or ‘has not developed’ these items therefore overreach the available evidence.
